eventObjectives.name: checkout-completion
eventObjectives.eligiblePopulation: accepted checkout attempts with a terminal result
eventObjectives.goodDefinition: order committed exactly once and confirmation returned within 2 seconds

eventObjectives.name: catalog-read
eventObjectives.eligiblePopulation: valid catalog reads reaching the public edge
eventObjectives.goodDefinition: correct non-stale response returned within 500 milliseconds

timeObjective.name: merchant-portal-reachability
timeObjective.goodDefinition: a representative authenticated synthetic journey can load the portal and retrieve a known test record

latencyObjective.name: search-latency
latencyObjective.eligiblePopulation: valid interactive searches excluding explicitly documented load tests
latencyObjective.goodDefinition: correct complete result has time to last byte at or below 400 milliseconds

lowTraffic.name: monthly-settlement-trigger
lowTraffic.singleFailureImpact: one merchant settlement is delayed until an authorized replay

policy.reliabilityChange: idempotency fix with canary and rollback
